reading.body:
Every model in this category carries the same advisory: cross-border data review is advised before use, because all seven are China-jurisdiction products.

The vendors span the largest platforms in Chinese technology, including ByteDance, Baidu, Tencent, Alibaba Cloud, and Xiaomi, alongside specialist AI firms Zhipu AI and MiniMax. That breadth indicates foundation model development in China is not concentrated in a single organization but distributed across both general-purpose internet platforms and dedicated AI labs. The data does not speak to model architecture, parameter count, benchmark performance, or the compute infrastructure behind any of these systems.

What the data does establish is a compliance baseline. Any organization evaluating these tools for deployment outside China faces the same starting question regardless of which vendor it considers. The cross-border data advisory is uniform, which means the legal and data-governance review is a prerequisite, not an afterthought, for every entry here. The data does not specify which regulations trigger that advisory, so readers will need to consult their own legal counsel for jurisdiction-specific obligations.
